messages:
elaine: Quick design review — small UX thing in the playground run preview for tool-calls.

elaine: When a function returns structured output we collapse the schema by default. Users can't tell at a glance which tool ran and whether the schema was applied. Suggest we show a 1-line summary header: "Tool: order_lookup (schema applied) — 3 fields" and an affordance to expand.

sam: +1 on header. Also suggest the expand chevron be keyboard focusable (tab order). VoiceOver currently reads nothing for the collapsed card.

mike: Accessibility nit: the chevron-only affordance doesn't have an aria-label. We should add aria-expanded and a label like "Expand tool output details".

ash: Copy tweak: instead of "schema applied" maybe "structured output validated" — feels clearer to non-devs.

elaine: I like "validated". But worried it implies guarantee. Maybe "matches schema"? Thoughts?

sam: "Matches schema" is neutral. "Validated" is fine if we also show validation warnings when mismatches occur.

mike: Regarding run history: when you click the tool-run summary it jumps you to the timeline but loses keyboard focus. We need to set focus to the expanded run panel. Also add a skip link for screenreader users.

ash: Small UI ask: show the tool icon (mini puzzle piece) next to the header so it reads as a single hit visually.

ux-bot: Auto-checklist created: 1) add 1-line header for tool-run (copy: "Tool: {name} — matches schema"), 2) add aria-expanded/aria-label to chevron, 3) ensure chevron is tabbable, 4) focus management when expanding from run history, 5) show tool icon in header, 6) add validation warnings surface. Please add owners and PRs.

elaine: I'll pair with Mike on a PR for aria bits. Sam can take the run-history focus changes. Ash can prototype the header copy + icon. 

sam: Will prototype focus behavior today.

mike: Opening a small PR for aria attributes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/952

ash: I'll drop mockups in #design after lunch.

elaine: Thanks all! If nobody objects I'll land the copy "matches schema" in the header. :thumbsup:

sam: :+1:

mike: :thumbsup:

ash: :ok_hand:

elaine: tagging followup for next week's design sync.
